extraction.name: SeamlessM4T
extraction.creator: Meta AI Research
extraction.citeAs: SeamlessM4T: Massively Multilingual & Multimodal Machine Translation
extraction.rai:dataCollection: 1 million hours of open speech audio data were used to learn self-supervised speech representations with w2v-BERT 2.0. A multimodal corpus of automatically aligned speech translations, dubbed SeamlessAlign, was created.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Software Collection, Web Scraping, Passive Data Collection
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Missing data in the dataset is not explicitly discussed.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data collection consists of 1 million hours of open speech audio data and a sentence-segmented dataset drawn from NLLB.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: The timeframe of the data collection process is not explicitly stated.
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: The data imputation process is not explicitly discussed.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The data manipulation process is not explicitly discussed.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The data preprocessing steps include filtering out non-speech data, deduplication of audio file URLs, and resampling at 16KHz.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Human-labeled and pseudo-labeled data were used to develop the SeamlessM4T model.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: The platform used to collect annotations by human annotators is not explicitly stated.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The process of converting the 'raw' annotations into the final labels is not explicitly discussed.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: The number of human labels per dataset item is not explicitly stated.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: The demographics specifications about the annotators are not explicitly stated.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: w2v-BERT 2.0 was used for self-supervised speech representations.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The model weights for SeamlessM4T-Large (2.3B parameters) and SeamlessM4T-Medium (1.2B parameters), as well as their inference code and fine-tuning recipes, are open-sourced and accessible at https://github.com/facebookresearch/seamless_communication.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset does not explicitly mention collection of sensitive human attributes.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: SeamlessM4T has the potential to augment world-readiness by streamlining multilingual exchange across various contexts, allowing on-demand access to world-readiness.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: SeamlessM4T was evaluated for gender bias and added toxicity. The model showed comparable results to state-of-the-art models, but overgeneralizes to masculine forms when translating from neutral terms.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The model has limitations, including potential quality degradation for long-form translation, and is not intended for production deployment.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: SeamlessM4T can be used for ASR, S2ST, S2TT, T2ST, T2TT, and TTS tasks.
